title: Writing
description: Academic Writing: Task 1 describes visual information (at least 150 words, about 20 minutes) and Task 2 is an essay (at least 250 words, about 40 minutes). Task 2 counts more. General Training Task 1 is a letter instead.

id.title: Writing
id.description: Academic Writing: Task 1 mendeskripsikan informasi visual (minimal 150 kata, sekitar 20 menit) dan Task 2 berupa esai (minimal 250 kata, sekitar 40 menit). Bobot Task 2 lebih besar. Di General Training, Task 1 berupa surat.

nodes.title: Task 1: Graphs, Charts & Tables
nodes.summary: Write an overview and compare key figures from line graphs, bar charts, pie charts and tables.

objectives.text: Write a clear overview of the main trends or differences without listing every number
Describe changes over time with accurate verbs, adverbs and tenses (rose sharply, fell slightly)
Compare and group data using comparatives, superlatives and approximate figures

id.title: Task 1: Grafik, Diagram & Tabel
id.summary: Menulis gambaran umum dan membandingkan angka-angka kunci dari grafik garis, diagram batang, diagram lingkaran dan tabel.

objectives.overview: Menulis gambaran umum (overview) yang jelas tentang tren atau perbedaan utama tanpa menyebut semua angka
objectives.describe-trends: Mendeskripsikan perubahan dari waktu ke waktu dengan kata kerja, adverbia dan tenses yang tepat (rose sharply, fell slightly)
objectives.compare-data: Membandingkan dan mengelompokkan data dengan comparative, superlative dan angka perkiraan

nodes.title: Task 1: Processes & Maps
nodes.summary: Describe the stages of a process or the changes shown on maps or plans.

objectives.text: Describe the stages of a process in order using the passive and sequencing words
Describe how a place changed between two maps using location language and past or present perfect forms

id.title: Task 1: Proses & Peta
id.summary: Mendeskripsikan tahapan suatu proses atau perubahan yang ditunjukkan peta atau denah.

objectives.process-stages: Mendeskripsikan tahapan proses secara berurutan dengan kalimat pasif dan kata penanda urutan
objectives.map-changes: Mendeskripsikan perubahan suatu tempat di antara dua peta dengan bahasa lokasi dan bentuk past atau present perfect

nodes.title: Task 2: Understanding the Question
nodes.summary: Work out what a Task 2 prompt asks: a point of view, an argument or a problem, and every part you must answer.

objectives.text: Identify what a prompt asks for (give an opinion, discuss two views, explain causes or solutions, weigh advantages and disadvantages)
List every part of a prompt that the essay must address
Write a thesis statement that gives a clear position relevant to the question

id.title: Task 2: Memahami Soal
id.summary: Memahami apa yang diminta soal Task 2: sudut pandang, argumen atau masalah, dan semua bagian yang harus dijawab.

objectives.identify-task: Menentukan apa yang diminta soal (memberi pendapat, membahas dua pandangan, menjelaskan sebab atau solusi, menimbang kelebihan dan kekurangan)
objectives.all-parts: Mendaftar setiap bagian soal yang harus dijawab esai
objectives.clear-position: Menulis thesis statement dengan posisi yang jelas dan relevan dengan soal

nodes.title: Task 2: Planning & Writing the Essay
nodes.summary: Plan in a few minutes, then write a well-organised essay of at least 250 words in about 40 minutes.

objectives.text: Plan an essay with an introduction, two or three body paragraphs and a conclusion
Develop each body paragraph with a topic sentence, explanation and a relevant example
Link sentences and paragraphs with a range of cohesive devices without overusing them

id.title: Task 2: Merencanakan & Menulis Esai
id.summary: Merencanakan dalam beberapa menit, lalu menulis esai yang tertata minimal 250 kata dalam sekitar 40 menit.

objectives.essay-plan: Merencanakan esai dengan pendahuluan, dua atau tiga paragraf isi dan kesimpulan
objectives.develop-ideas: Mengembangkan setiap paragraf isi dengan kalimat topik, penjelasan dan contoh yang relevan
objectives.cohesion: Menghubungkan kalimat dan paragraf dengan beragam penanda kohesi tanpa berlebihan

nodes.title: Writing Criteria: Range & Accuracy
nodes.summary: Raise your Lexical resource and Grammatical range and accuracy, and check your own writing against the four criteria.

objectives.text: Explain the four Writing criteria and how Task 1 and Task 2 are weighted
Use a mix of simple and complex sentences (relative clauses, conditionals) accurately
Find and correct common errors (articles, subject-verb agreement, word form) in your own writing

id.title: Kriteria Writing: Ragam & Akurasi
id.summary: Meningkatkan Lexical resource serta Grammatical range and accuracy, dan menilai tulisanmu sendiri dengan empat kriteria.

objectives.four-criteria: Menjelaskan empat kriteria Writing dan bobot Task 1 dan Task 2
objectives.complex-sentences: Menggunakan campuran kalimat sederhana dan kompleks (relative clause, conditional) dengan akurat
objectives.self-edit: Menemukan dan memperbaiki kesalahan umum (artikel, kesesuaian subjek-kata kerja, bentuk kata) di tulisan sendiri

nodes.title: General Training Task 1: Letters
nodes.summary: For General Training only: write a letter of at least 150 words that covers all three bullet points in the right tone.

objectives.text: Identify the purpose of the letter and cover all three bullet points in the prompt
Choose a personal, semi-formal or formal tone and use matching openings and closings
Write the letter as continuous paragraphs, not notes or bullet points

id.title: General Training Task 1: Surat
id.summary: Khusus General Training: menulis surat minimal 150 kata yang mencakup ketiga poin soal dengan nada yang tepat.

objectives.letter-purpose: Menentukan tujuan surat dan membahas ketiga poin di soal
objectives.letter-tone: Memilih nada personal, semi-formal atau formal dan memakai salam pembuka dan penutup yang sesuai
objectives.letter-paragraphs: Menulis surat dalam paragraf utuh, bukan catatan atau poin-poin
